title: Consultor de Recrutamento Júnior
description:
Recém-formado(a)? Fala inglês fluente e quer construir uma carreira onde sua renda depende diretamente dos seus esforços?

Nossa startup de recrutamento está buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Recrutamento Júnior .

Não buscamos um especialista pronto. Buscamos alguém com "brilho nos olhos", que possamos treinar no verdadeiro modelo 360  (sim, isso inclui Vendas e Recrutamento!). Você estará na origem da empresa, trabalhando lado a lado com os fundadores.

O que você vai fazer (e o que vamos te ensinar):

  • Parte 1: Negociação e Vendas (Prospecção)
  • Prospectar e atrair novos clientes (B2B), usando LinkedIn e contatos "frios".
  • Aprender a negociar com Diretores de RH e CEOs, fechando contratos de R&S.
  • Desenvolver relações de longo prazo com as empresas, tornando-se um parceiro estratégico.
  • Parte 2: Recrutamento (Delivery)
  • Conduzir o ciclo completo de recrutamento (do briefing com o cliente até a oferta).
  • Fazer "hunting" ativo dos melhores candidatos do mercado, que não estão em busca de emprego.
  • Conduzir entrevistas, avaliar perfis e apresentar os candidatos aos clientes.

Nosso(a) candidato(a) ideal:

  • Possui Ensino Superior completo.
  • Fala Inglês em nível avançado/fluente (conversacional)  — você vai se comunicar com candidatos e clientes internacionais.
  • Tem excelentes habilidades de comunicação:  você não tem medo de telefone, sabe ouvir, articula bem as ideias e tem poder de persuasão.
  • Tem um enorme desejo de se desenvolver  em negociação (vendas) e recrutamento (R&S).
  • É autônomo(a), proativo(a) e pronto(a) para atuar no ambiente dinâmico de uma startup.

Experiência prévia em R&S ou vendas é um diferencial, mas seu desejo e suas habilidades de comunicação são mais importantes.

O que oferecemos:

  • 100% Remoto (Home Office):  Trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Treinamento intensivo no modelo 360:  Vamos investir em você e transformá-lo(a) em um(a) consultor(a) de ponta.
  • Plano de carreira transparente:  Critérios claros de crescimento de Júnior a Sócio(a).
  • Salário e Motivação:  Salário base  competitivo (CLT) + alta remuneração variável (comissão)  baseada em seus resultados comerciais.
  • Impacto direto no negócio:  Zero burocracia. Suas ideias serão ouvidas e implementadas.

Pronto(a) para construir sua carreira e mudar sua vida?

Envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação (em inglês ou português), explicando por que você quer ser um(a) consultor(a) 360.

title: Analista SRE SR - Inglês
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa dedicada e com vontade de fazer a diferença para atuar na área de SRE/DEVOPS. Se você ama tecnologia, gosta de desafios e acredita no poder da colaboração para alcançar grandes resultados, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Projetar, automatizar e evoluir ambientes em Azure com foco em resiliência e observabilidade .

Gerenciar e manter infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .

Operar e otimizar clusters Kubernetes (AKS) , garantindo eficiência e governança (namespaces, deployments, ingress, secrets, Helm charts).

Implementar e gerenciar pipelines CI/CD , integrando práticas de automação, segurança e qualidade contínua.

Monitorar sistemas com Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash) , promovendo visibilidade e métricas operacionais.

Atuar na resposta e gestão de incidentes , análise de causa raiz e melhoria contínua da confiabilidade.

Trabalhar com APIM, Firewalls, Key Vault, Blob Storage e Azure SQL de forma integrada e segura.

Implementar políticas de autenticação e segurança (OAuth 2.0, tokens, Entra ID/Azure AD ).

Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na padronização de APIs RESTful (síncronas e assíncronas) e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Acionamento e Plantão


Requisitos e qualificações

Inglês Avançado pra conversação

Experiência sólida com Azure Cloud (AKS, APIM, Firewall, Key Vault, Blob Storage, SQL).

Domínio em Kubernetes (Namespaces, Deployments, Helm, Ingress, Secrets).

Proficiência em Terraform (Infraestrutura como Código).

Vivência com Stack Elastic e ferramentas de observabilidade (Elastic, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).

Experiência em CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI ou similares).

Conhecimento em autenticação, segurança e controle de acesso (OAuth 2.0, Entra ID) .

Familiaridade com padrões RESTful e arquitetura de APIs .

Experiência prática em análise de performance, troubleshooting e gestão de incidentes .


Informações Adcionais

Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;


Trabalho Remoto;


Horário de trabalho flexível: De acordo com área de atuação e política interna;


Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

title: Cozinheira
description:
Cozinheiro(a) — Café Bonjour

O Café Bonjour é um espaço acolhedor, cheio de plantinhas, mimos e sabores preparados com carinho. Acreditamos que a cozinha é a alma da casa, e buscamos alguém que compartilhe desse cuidado, que valorize a estética, o sabor e a experiência que entregamos aos nossos clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Preparar e finalizar todos os itens salgados e doces do cardápio conforme fichas técnicas.
  • Garantir padronização, estética bonita e alto padrão de sabor em cada prato.
  • Realizar pré-preparo diário, organização da praça e reposição dos insumos da cozinha.
  • Manusear alimentos com excelência em higiene, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Controlar tempos de preparo, qualidade e agilidade no fluxo de pedidos.
  • Manter limpeza, organização e zelo pelos equipamentos, utensílios e ambiente.
  • Contribuir com ideias para melhorias de processos e novos preparos.
  • Trabalhar em equipe, mantendo um ambiente leve, colaborativo e profissional.


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como cozinheiro(a) — cafeteria, bistrô, padaria ou restaurante são diferenciais.
  • Capricho, organização e senso estético.
  • Saber fazer preparos de alimentos como carnes por exemplo
  • Agilidade, responsabilidade e boa comunicação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob demanda, mantendo qualidade e calma.
  • Proatividade e vontade de crescer com a equipe.


Benefícios

  • Salário fixo:  R$ 1.550,00 + Comissão mensal
  • Comissão mensal:  média entre R$ 1.300 e R$ 2.400
  • Vale-transporte

Média salarial mensal: cerca de R$ 3.000,00


Após período de experiência (3 meses):

  • Plano de saúde integral
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Cartão alimentação e refeição
  • Acesso ao TotalPass


Horários

  • Terça a Sexta: 11h30 às 20h30
  • Sábado: 10h às 19h30
  • Domingo: 7h30 às 13h30
  • Segunda-feira: folga fixa

title: AWS Developer (Data Lake)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior AWS Developer to support the design and implementation of a large-scale data lake and analytics platform within a leading financial institution. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical expertise across the AWS ecosystem and the ability to deliver complex solutions independently while collaborating effectively within a high-performing engineering team.


Key Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and workflows within the AWS ecosystem.

· Build and optimize components for the data lake using Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, and Iceberg.

· Write efficient and maintainable Python or Spark scripts for data ingestion, transformation, and automation.

· Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform to deploy and manage AWS services.

· Collaborate with cross-functional team members to ensure high-quality, performant, and reliable data delivery.

· Contribute to code reviews, testing improvements, and performance optimization.

· Participate in solution design discussions, bringing forward ideas and accepting feedback in a collaborative, team-first manner.

Required Qualifications

· Strong AWS expertise, especially in data and analytics services (Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, Iceberg).

· Proficient in Python or Spark scripting for automation and data engineering tasks.

· Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles.

· Solid understanding of data modeling, analytics platforms, and SQL.

· Experience working in financial services and familiarity with banking data terminology,

· Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team of senior developers.

· Strong focus on performance, code quality, and continuous improvement.

· Takes initiative to identify opportunities for improvement in testing, performance, and architecture.

· Communicates constructively and is open to giving and receiving feedback.

· Balances ownership and teamwork, understanding that success is a collective effort.

· Fluent English.


Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Remote from Brazil.

title: Sr Python Data Engineer
description:
Senior Python Data Engineer

About the Project


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance data processing pipelines using Python libraries (Pandas, Polars).
  • Develop and expose RESTful APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Consume and process normalized Parquet files from multiple upstream sources to generate dynamic Excel reports.
  • Contribute to a spec-driven development workflow (using GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to scaffold and generate API/data pipeline code.
  • Optimize report generation logic for speed and scalability, currently targeting sub-20 second response times.
  • Integrate with messaging and storage mechanisms (e.g., Service Bus, Storage Accounts).
  • Collaborate on infrastructure-as-code automation using Bicep (or similar IaC tools).
  • Participate in design discussions for future migration to Snowflake and/or a data lake architecture.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing (must have expertise in Pandas, nice to have: Polars, openpyxl).
  • Experience building backend services or APIs using frameworks like FastAPI.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling principles (Star Schema) and handling normalized datasets.
  • Familiarity with enterprise messaging patterns and data integration from various sources (API-based and file-based).
  • Experience working with GitHub and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Bicep or comparable tools (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Comfort with spec-driven development and leveraging AI tools like GitHub Copilot for scaffolding.

title: Microsoft MAUI Developer
description:
Job Description — Microsoft MAUI Developer

Developros is partnering with a U.S. technology team to add a Microsoft MAUI Developer who can contribute to a modern cross-platform application used by thousands of customers. This role is ideal for a self-managing engineer with strong communication skills and a product mindset. You’ll work in real time with a U.S. team, shaping both the technical direction and the user experience.


Role Overview

You will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile/desktop applications using .NET MAUI. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in C#, architectural thinking, and an ability to collaborate closely with product and design. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and naturally contributes to team alignment and momentum.


Key Responsibilities
  • Develop high-quality mobile and desktop applications using .NET MAUI.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams in real time (EST/PST overlap).
  • Implement clean architecture, maintainable code, and scalable patterns.
  • Integrate REST APIs, authentication flows, and cloud services (Azure preferred).
  • Build UI components with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, optimize performance, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint rituals, and product planning discussions.


Required Skills & Experience
  • 3+ years of experience with C#/.NET development.
  • Hands-on experience with MAUI, Xamarin, or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of MVVM patterns and reactive architectures.
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with cloud platforms (Azure is a plus).
  • Solid understanding of mobile/desktop lifecycle, memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating directly with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Strong English communication, emotional intelligence, and proactive ownership.


Nice to Have
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Background in UI/UX collaboration or component design.
  • Experience with push notifications, offline sync, or advanced mobile capabilities.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and instrumentation.


What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Joining through Developros means working with a partner that prioritizes team chemistry, long-term alignment, and human-centered collaboration . Our developers operate as trusted extensions of U.S. teams — not outsourced executors. You’ll work with leaders who value initiative, clarity, and craftsmanship.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil-based)
description:
About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.


About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands-on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real-world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.


Key Competencies

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high-performing follow-the-sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer-focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first-line and second-line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client-facing issues.

Collaboration with Platform Engineering (NZ)

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:

-Puppet 8 migration

-Python 3.13 upgrade

-CDK migration

-CI/CD unification

-Platform hardening

-Test rig and E2E reliability improvements

  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

System Health & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:

-edge hardware reliability

-network stability

-server provisioning consistency

-observability for both cloud and on-prem components

  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.


Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, implementation, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Technical

  • Strong background in DevOps, SRE, or Production Engineering environments.
  • Hands-on experience operating hybrid cloud + on-premise / edge systems.
  • Proficiency with:

-Datadog (or similar observability platforms)

-AWS (IAM, networking, security, monitoring)

-Containerization (Docker)

-Kubernetes / K3S

-IaC tools (AWS CDK ideal)

  • Solid programming skills in Python (TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus).
  • Understanding of security best practices (identity, access, endpoint, and network security).

Operational

  • Experience running incident response, on-call processes, or follow-the-sun operations.
  • Proven ability to write and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Experience supporting industrial, IoT, or hardware-integrated systems (ideal).


About Us

Mindhive Ltd is a fast-moving AI company using machine learning and computer vision to reimagine industrial systems. Our products run across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments, bringing AI performance and reliability directly to the factory floor.

We care deeply about people, quality, and impact. We work collaboratively, iterate quickly, and tackle meaningful, complex problems.

Mindhive is a New Zealand Hi-Tech Awards winner, recognised for innovation and impact in software, AI, and advanced manufacturing.


Work Environment & Flexibility

We support hybrid and remote work, with our people distributed across Brazil, Portugal, Italy, Japan and New Zealand. We trust each other to deliver results in ways that suit our lives while maximising our collective impact. We move quickly, adapt fast, and support each other through the ups and downs that come with building something new and meaningful.


Our values

  • Relentless Curiosity - we explore deeply, question assumptions, and seek better ways.
  • Authentic Humanity - we support and care for people first.
  • Inclusive Connection - we collaborate openly and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Determination to Deliver - we strive to do the right thing, consistently and with purpose.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil-based)
description:
About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.


About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands-on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real-world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.


Key Competencies

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high-performing follow-the-sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer-focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first-line and second-line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client-facing issues.

Collaboration with Platform Engineering (NZ)

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:

-Puppet 8 migration

-Python 3.13 upgrade

-CDK migration

-CI/CD unification

-Platform hardening

-Test rig and E2E reliability improvements

  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

System Health & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:

-edge hardware reliability

-network stability

-server provisioning consistency

-observability for both cloud and on-prem components

  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.


Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, implementation, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Technical

  • Strong background in DevOps, SRE, or Production Engineering environments.
  • Hands-on experience operating hybrid cloud + on-premise / edge systems.
  • Proficiency with:

-Datadog (or similar observability platforms)

-AWS (IAM, networking, security, monitoring)

-Containerization (Docker)

-Kubernetes / K3S

-IaC tools (AWS CDK ideal)

  • Solid programming skills in Python (TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus).
  • Understanding of security best practices (identity, access, endpoint, and network security).

Operational

  • Experience running incident response, on-call processes, or follow-the-sun operations.
  • Proven ability to write and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Experience supporting industrial, IoT, or hardware-integrated systems (ideal).


About Us

Mindhive Ltd is a fast-moving AI company using machine learning and computer vision to reimagine industrial systems. Our products run across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments, bringing AI performance and reliability directly to the factory floor.

We care deeply about people, quality, and impact. We work collaboratively, iterate quickly, and tackle meaningful, complex problems.

Mindhive is a New Zealand Hi-Tech Awards winner, recognised for innovation and impact in software, AI, and advanced manufacturing.


Work Environment & Flexibility

We support hybrid and remote work, with our people distributed across Brazil, Portugal, Italy, Japan and New Zealand. We trust each other to deliver results in ways that suit our lives while maximising our collective impact. We move quickly, adapt fast, and support each other through the ups and downs that come with building something new and meaningful.


Our values

  • Relentless Curiosity - we explore deeply, question assumptions, and seek better ways.
  • Authentic Humanity - we support and care for people first.
  • Inclusive Connection - we collaborate openly and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Determination to Deliver - we strive to do the right thing, consistently and with purpose.

title: Consultor de Automação Inteligente
description:
A Practia é uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina, presente em 9 países. Somos especialistas em Transformação Digital e Hiperautomação e levamos inovação tecnológica para clientes no Brasil e no mundo. Estamos em constante crescimento e buscamos um profissional que queira crescer conosco atuando como Consultor de automação inteligente . Irá apoiar no plano de avaliação do modelo operativo dos centros de excelência (COE) de hiperautomação, com o foco em detalhamento normativo, definição de padronização e planejamento do uso otimizado das estruturas envolvidas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar na definição de estratégias e modelos para implementação de automação inteligente.
  • Participar da criação de políticas, processos e padrões que sustentem a automação de forma segura e escalável.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento e execução de iniciativas de automação, garantindo alinhamento com objetivos do negócio.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de planos de integração e evolução tecnológica.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio e tecnologia para garantir eficiência e conformidade nas soluções.
  • Orientar stakeholders sobre boas práticas e uso de ferramentas de automação.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e consultiva em projetos de automação inteligente.

Pré requisitos

  • Experiência em análise e diagnóstico de processos de negócio.
  • Vivência em projetos de automação inteligente (RPA, IA).
  • Formação mínima Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação: Automation Anywhere, Power Platform (Microsoft), Python e similares.
  • Habilidade para comunicação clara e gestão de stakeholders.


Requisitos desejáveis

Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em Automação de Processos, Gestão de Projetos ou Transformação Digital.

title: Analista de pré-vendas - Smart
description:
Buscamos um Analista de Pré-vendas Jr, para atuar no front-end do ciclo de vendas e no back office da nossa Mesa Smart. Você será o(a) primeiro(a) contato da Nobel Capital com prospects de alto potencial. Esta função é crítica para nossa expansão e para otimizar a eficiência da nossa prospecção.


Responsabilidades:


Prospecção Ativa (Outbound) : Realizar contato ativo (via telefone, e-mail e LinkedIn) com prospects de alto potencial, com foco em investidores e grandes patrimônios.

Qualificação de Leads Gerados por IA : Utilizar os insights preditivos e as listas de leads gerados pela Mesa Smart de AI para priorizar e realizar a pré-qualificação dos contatos.

Agendamento e Transição : Qualificar rigorosamente os prospects (identificando fit, budget e timing de investimento) e agendar reuniões de follow-up (passagem de bastão) para o Assessor de Investimento (Closer).

Otimização de Roteiros (Playbooks) : Colaborar com o time de Vendas e Marketing para aprimorar os roteiros de prospecção (cold calls, e-mails, etc.) com base nos dados de conversão e nos insights da IA.

Gestão de CRM : Manter o CRM atualizado com o status de cada prospect e gerar relatórios de performance (taxas de conversão, pipeline gerado e qualidade dos leads).

Pesquisa de Mercado : Apoiar a Mesa Smart na identificação de targets e tendências do mercado que possam ser utilizadas para personalizar a abordagem de vendas.


Qualificações:


Conhecimento básico de finanças e mercado de capitais.

Busca por crescimento de carreira para Assessor de Investimento (AI) ou especialista de Wealth.

Certificação Ancord

title: Limpador - Colaboração Paga (Consultoria Técnica)
description:
Título: Especialista em Limpeza | Colaboração Paga (Consultoria Técnica)


Descrição:

A mybest Brasil está em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência prática em limpeza doméstica para colaborar como consultor(a) especialista em nossos guias de compra e artigos sobre produtos e ferramentas para o lar.


Entre os temas que abordamos estão limpadores para azulejos e rejuntes, repelentes de pragas, aspiradores de pó, máquinas de lavar e outros produtos usados no dia a dia da casa .


Como funciona a colaboração:

  • Questionário: responder um breve formulário online indicando os critérios mais importantes para escolher cada tipo de produto (efetividade, segurança, facilidade de uso, durabilidade, custo-benefício, o que evitar etc.).
  • Revisão do artigo: revisar o rascunho antes da publicação para garantir precisão técnica e clareza nas recomendações.
  • Crédito: seu nome e mini bio aparecerão como especialista no artigo. Se tiver site ou blog profissional , incluímos o link no perfil (excelente oportunidade para aumentar sua autoridade e visibilidade).


Condições da colaboração:

  • Pagamento: R$ 350 por artigo (questionário + revisão).
  • Pagamento realizado até o dia 20 do mês seguinte à entrega.
  • Colaboração pontual, 100% remota.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada em limpeza e organização residencial , com conhecimento prático sobre produtos e utensílios domésticos.
  • Capacidade de emitir NFS-e de serviço de consultoria por CNPJ próprio fora do regime MEI .
  • Possuir site ou blog profissional ativo (não apenas redes sociais).


Desejável:

  • Familiaridade com Google Docs e Google Forms .
  • Clareza e objetividade ao transformar experiência prática em recomendações úteis para o público.


Observação:

Recebemos um volume alto de candidaturas e priorizamos respostas rápidas. Entraremos em contato por e-mail apenas com os candidatos cujo perfil atender às necessidades do projeto.


Sobre a mybest:

A mybest é a maior plataforma de recomendações de produtos do Japão, com operação em mais de 10 países, incluindo o Brasil. Nossos conteúdos combinam pesquisa editorial com a experiência de especialistas para ajudar milhões de leitores a comprar com segurança e confiança.


Se você é profissional de limpeza e quer compartilhar seu conhecimento com um público amplo, candidate-se e conte um pouco sobre sua experiência!

Sobre a Oportunidade:


A Partnervision está selecionando Executivo de Vendas para vaga Hunter, com foco em gerar resultados na prospecção de Clientes B&B, nos segmentos aeroespacial, automotivo, bens de consumo, industrial, energia, mineração, naval, eletroeletrônico, alta tecnologia e equipamentos médicos, entre outros.  · Competências Pessoais: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, apresentação, relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe. Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas, com foco em resultados.

· Plano de saúde e odontológico.

· Vale-refeição e vale-transporte.

· Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamentos contínuos.

· Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico.

· Forma de Contrato: A/C

· Fará parte de uma equipe experiente e multidisciplinar, que valoriza a troca de conhecimentos e o desenvolvimento de carreira.

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Hartmann Young is partnered with a fast-growing global leader in health, nutrition, and wellness ingredients, known for its science-led innovation and rapid international expansion. As the business continues to scale, we are seeking a dynamic Business Development Manager South America to drive immediate commercial impact and elevate the company’s presence across the nutraceutical market.


We’re looking for someone who brings genuine industry influence, including:

  • A strong book of business and established relationships with brand owners, CMOs/CDMOs, and major consumer health companies
  • Proven success selling key nutraceutical dosage forms — tablets, capsules, softgels, and gummys.


If you’re commercially driven, well-connected, and excited by the opportunity to shape partnerships in a high-growth environment, this role offers an exceptional platform to make a meaningful and immediate impact.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business growth by leveraging your existing network and opening high-value commercial opportunities
  • Develop and expand strategic partnerships with global key accounts, brand owners, distributors, and contract manufacturers
  • Lead the full business development cycle — from opportunity identification to negotiation and long-term strategic planning
  • Translate scientific and technical capabilities into compelling commercial propositions
  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to deliver integrated go-to-market strategies
  • Manage contracts, commercial terms, and performance optimisation across partnership lifecycles
  • Support international expansion through new market development and strategic alliances
  • Represent the business at leading industry trade shows and events to strengthen brand visibility and network reach.


Key Requirements

  • You can be located anywhere within South America to qualify for this market.
  • 8+ years’ experience in business development, partnerships, or commercial leadership within nutraceuticals, ingredients, food, or life sciences within South America.
  • A well-established book of business and strong relationships across the nutraceutical ecosystem
  • Direct experience selling tablets, capsules, softgels, gummys, or related dosage forms
  • Proven ability to generate revenue growth and close complex commercial agreements
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to convert technical innovation into business value
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth, hands-on environment
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

title: Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience using Ruby on Rails to join as a core member of our U.S. client's tight-knit, experienced engineering team. In this role, you will play a leadership role as well as actively contribute to strategizing and building at the feature level rather than just focusing on outputs.

Our client is a venture capital-backed health tech company transforming the industry's coding practices by creating a marketplace that connects healthcare companies with over 4,000 certified coding specialists. The client is focused on expanding quickly its product, engineering, and design teams with passionate builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment to support its rapid growth.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders to define, design, and build new features and integrations
  • Advance software platform capabilities using Ruby on Rails
  • Develop and support third-party integrations with B2B healthcare systems
  • Provide work estimates for bug fixes, enhancements, and features
  • Deliver high-quality, well-documented code with velocity
  • Mentor junior engineers and aid the engineering team with troubleshooting
  • Write and execute unit tests
  • Promote development best practices following team standards with an eye towards innovation and opportunities to scale
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight and a bias towards action as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Become energized by tackling new challenges and eagerly give and receive feedback from colleagues


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience using Ruby on Rails, including version 7+, with a strong background in JavaScript and frameworks (preferably Stimulus)
  • Experience taking the lead on complete features, appropriate to your level, and showing initiative to solve ambiguous problems
  • Experience creating and consuming APIs
  • Knowledge of relational / non-relational database systems
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech industry, or growth stage startups
  • Experience with Stimulus, Turbo, Tailwind, Sidekiq, or Heroku Shield


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Master Data Manager
description:
Vaga: MDM Tester – Híbrido em São Paulo


Estamos em busca de um(a) MDM Tester experiente e detalhista para se juntar ao nosso time e contribuir com o sucesso da nossa iniciativa de Master Data Management (MDM) .


A posição é híbrida em São Paulo , com a oportunidade de atuar em projetos de dados de grande porte e impacto global.


Como MDM Tester , você será responsável por investigar e resolver falhas de qualidade de dados, analisar fontes e processos de ingestão, além de garantir a precisão, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados mestres em diversos sistemas.

  • Testar e validar dados mestres, assegurando qualidade, consistência e precisão entre diferentes sistemas;

  • Colaborar com times de negócio e tecnologia para garantir alinhamento em políticas de governança e qualidade de dados;
  • Apoiar fluxos e automações de dados, contribuindo com melhorias contínuas nos pipelines.


✅ Requisitos

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Data/ETL Testing ;
  • 6+ anos de experiência em gestão e governança de qualidade de dados em ambiente MDM;
  • Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de dados e integração de dados ;
  • Experiência com ferramentas ETL (Ab Initio, AWS Glue, Informatica, Alteryx);
  • Vivência com CI/CD (GitLab) e práticas de DevOps/DataOps ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com equipes multifuncionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com MDM em nuvem ;
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de migração, validação ou limpeza de dados em larga escala.
  • Experiência prática com Stibo MDM ;

title: Saas Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager who will become a strategic partner to the CEO and take full ownership of the marketing function.

You will be the key person responsible for building the marketing strategy, managing the team, and driving company growth.


Key Areas of Responsibility

Cross-functional marketing team leadership

  • Manage a team of SMM specialists, media buyers, email marketers, and content creators
  • Create clear briefs and tasks for designers and copywriters
  • Coordinate workflows between Marketing ↔ Sales ↔ Product
  • Ensure quality and timely execution across all marketing activities

Content strategy & production

  • Develop and oversee the content strategy across all channels
  • Lead the creation of client case studies (we have 100+ success stories!)
  • Adapt marketing and educational content for new markets (EU, US)
  • Maintain a consistent tone of voice and content quality

Growth & lead generation

  • Plan and host webinars and educational events
  • Launch email sequences, tripwires, and marketing funnels
  • Set up chatbot automation flows (Telegram, website)
  • Build partnerships and collaborations to scale lead generation

Analytics & optimization

  • Track channel performance, CAC, CPL, and funnel metrics
  • Calculate campaign ROI and conversion improvements
  • Optimize active campaigns to improve CAC, LTV and retention
  • Build and refine CJMs and conversion funnels

Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • Marketing team exists, but execution lacks consistency — we need a system
  • Sales launched in Europe (Finland, Germany) — marketing needs localization
  • Sales launched for English-speaking U.S. audiences — marketing must adapt
  • We have 100+ client case studies and podcast episodes ready for marketing use


Challenges you will help solve:

Content

  • No consistent content production framework
  • Client case studies are produced irregularly
  • Need adaptation for new markets
  • Content quality must be stabilized and elevated

Processes

  • Team accountability and task ownership must be improved
  • Need transparent metric tracking for optimization
  • No unified coordination between Marketing ↔ Sales

Scaling

  • Growth goal: 3× in 6 months
  • Expansion into new markets (Finland, Germany)
  • Strengthening position in the U.S.
  • Channel diversification and testing


What You Will Do

Strategy & Leadership (30%)

  • Build quarterly / monthly / weekly marketing plans
  • Manage and mentor SMM, email, and paid traffic teams
  • Write briefs and task descriptions for creatives and specialists
  • Run regular syncs with team and stakeholders
  • Prioritize initiatives and ensure deadlines are met

Content & Creative (25%)

  • Develop content strategy for SMM, email, webinars, landing pages
  • Lead the production of case studies and educational content
  • Work with designers and copywriters: briefs, quality review
  • Adapt content for different audiences and markets
  • Maintain a unified tone of voice

Lead Generation & Funnels (25%)

  • Plan and execute webinars end-to-end
  • Launch email campaigns, tripwires, and automated funnels
  • Build and optimize chatbot logic and conversion flows
  • Develop partnerships, media placements, and collaborations
  • Build CJMs and warming funnels

Analytics & Optimization (20%)

  • Analyze key metrics (CAC, CPL, conversions, ROI)
  • Produce channel and campaign performance reports
  • Optimize existing marketing activities based on data
  • Test new channels and hypotheses
  • Work with analytics tools (GA, CRM, marketing platforms)


Requirements

Must Have

Experience in EdTech or SaaS — 2+ years

  • Strong understanding of how educational/SaaS funnels work
  • B2C marketing experience in career/learning segments
  • Experience with performance metrics and ROI-oriented marketing

High-growth startup experience

  • Ability to work in a fast-changing environment
  • Skilled in prioritization and multitasking
  • Experience contributing to 2x–3x growth

Marketing team management — 1+ year

  • Ability to assign and brief tasks clearly
  • Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders
  • Delegation and performance oversight

Tools & technical marketing skills

  • Email marketing (Klaviyo, SendGrid, or similar)
  • Chatbots and automation funnels
  • Analytics (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel)
  • SMM + paid advertising experience
  • Webflow / Figma / Notion for content collaboration

CJM & funnel expertise

  • Experience designing customer journey maps
  • Building content-based nurturing funnels
  • Understanding of CAC, LTV, ROMI, conversion metrics

Strong Plus

Experience running webinars and online events

Copywriting and editing skills

Knowledge of U.S./EU job markets

Experience using LinkedIn for lead generation

Background in mission-driven or social impact projects

title: Senior Agile Tester
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Agile Tester who thrives in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and is passionate about ensuring quality from concept to deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with front-end developers, designers, and backend engineers to validate user experiences across responsive, content-driven applications built with modern technologies like React, Next.js, and headless CMSs.


Your mission is to advocate for quality across the entire product lifecycle — from exploratory testing and API validation to automation and continuous improvement within an agile delivery model.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners in agile ceremonies to define and validate acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test plans for web applications using React / Next.js, ensuring responsive behavior across devices and browsers.
  • Test CMS integrations (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity) and validate localization and marketing content workflows.
  • Verify API Gateway / BFF layer integrations, ensuring clean data aggregation and performance across multiple channels.
  • Conduct exploratory, regression, and usability testing for front-end components built with Tailwind CSS and Storybook systems.
  • Validate deployments built via Vite for performance, caching, and build integrity.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track defects using modern issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for both UI and API test coverage.
  • Ensure accessibility, performance, and content accuracy across localized experiences.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, preferably within agile or scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architectures (React, Next.js, or similar).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.


Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.
  • Knowledge of Vite builds, SSR, and hybrid rendering performance considerations.
  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.
  • Familiarity with automated cross-browser and device testing suites.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape quality practices in a modern, front-end–driven product ecosystem.
  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Tech Lead .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Front-End Developer with a strong foundation in modern web technologies to help us craft performant, scalable, and user-centric digital experiences. You’ll play a key role in building and maintaining a hybrid SSR-enabled front-end architecture powered by React or Next.js, while collaborating cross-functionally with design, product, and backend teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, device-optimized user interfaces using React or Next.js, leveraging SSR/SSG for performance and SEO.
  • Integrate with a headless CMS (Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity) to support localization and rapid content iterations.
  • Build and extend reusable front-end component libraries using Storybook (or similar) to ensure consistent design implementation.
  • Collaborate with designers in Figma to translate design systems into robust, maintainable UI components.
  • Work with the API Gateway / BFF (Backend for Frontend) layer to consume and aggregate APIs for multi-channel delivery, including integrating with Drupal APIs.
  • Style components using Tailwind CSS and maintain scalable, accessible CSS organization.
  • Optimize build and deployment pipelines using Vite for fast, modern front-end delivery.
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and accessibility across the stack.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in front-end development building production-grade applications.
  • Strong proficiency with React or Next.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity).
  • Proficiency in modern styling tools like Tailwind CSS.
  • Familiarity with API gateways or BFF patterns for decoupled front-ends.
  • Experience integrating with external systems (e.g., Drupal via REST or GraphQL APIs).
  • Solid understanding of UX/UI design principles and ability to work closely with design teams using Figma.
  • Hands-on experience in performance optimization, accessibility, and testing.


Nice to Have

  • Experience creating or maintaining internal design systems.
  • Knowledge of Storybook, Vite, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Passion for emerging front-end trends and developer experience improvements.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape an evolving, modern front-end architecture.
  • Collaborative and forward-thinking environment with design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Flexible work arrangements and emphasis on professional growth.

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Microsoft MAUI Developer
description:
Job Description — Microsoft MAUI Developer

Developros is partnering with a U.S. technology team to add a Microsoft MAUI Developer who can contribute to a modern cross-platform application used by thousands of customers. This role is ideal for a self-managing engineer with strong communication skills and a product mindset. You’ll work in real time with a U.S. team, shaping both the technical direction and the user experience.


Role Overview

You will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile/desktop applications using .NET MAUI. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in C#, architectural thinking, and an ability to collaborate closely with product and design. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and naturally contributes to team alignment and momentum.


Key Responsibilities
  • Develop high-quality mobile and desktop applications using .NET MAUI.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams in real time (EST/PST overlap).
  • Implement clean architecture, maintainable code, and scalable patterns.
  • Integrate REST APIs, authentication flows, and cloud services (Azure preferred).
  • Build UI components with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, optimize performance, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint rituals, and product planning discussions.


Required Skills & Experience
  • 3+ years of experience with C#/.NET development.
  • Hands-on experience with MAUI, Xamarin, or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of MVVM patterns and reactive architectures.
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with cloud platforms (Azure is a plus).
  • Solid understanding of mobile/desktop lifecycle, memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating directly with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Strong English communication, emotional intelligence, and proactive ownership.


Nice to Have
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Background in UI/UX collaboration or component design.
  • Experience with push notifications, offline sync, or advanced mobile capabilities.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and instrumentation.


What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Joining through Developros means working with a partner that prioritizes team chemistry, long-term alignment, and human-centered collaboration . Our developers operate as trusted extensions of U.S. teams — not outsourced executors. You’ll work with leaders who value initiative, clarity, and craftsmanship.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento que impactem a arquitetura corporativa.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.

- Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Liderança Técnica de equipes ágeis de alta performance.

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento
